statics.── 正面からは歯が立たない。退いて、出直せる。: — Head-on, you can't touch them. Step back; come again.
statics.道を押すと、見取り図にその道が描かれる。: Pick a route and the plan draws it.
statics.手元のカードを押すか、数字の 1〜5 で使う。: Press a card in hand, or use keys 1–5.
statics.記憶を一つ持ち帰れる：: You can carry one memory home:
statics.頼れば、カードを一枚戻してもらえる（借りができる）：: Lean on them and they'll restore one card (you'll owe them):
statics.カードを一枚拾える（拾うと決着を受け取る）：: You can pick up one card (picking up takes the resolution):
statics.ひと晩ここで（一枚を満たす・2 時間・次の出来事を逃す）: The night here (refill one card · 2 h · miss the next event)
statics.ひと晩かけて満たすカードを選ぶ: Choose a card to refill overnight
statics.底の見えない建物を、フロアごとに下りる。夜明けまでに最後の相手まで。初めのカード: A building with no bottom in sight. Go down it floor by floor. Reach the last foe before dawn. You start with 3 cards and 2 empty slots.
statics.光っている部屋を押すと、そこへ下りる。← → で選んで Enter でもいい。一: Press a lit room to go down to it. Or pick with ← → and hit Enter. Each floor down costs 1 hour.
statics.人の横の数字は硬度（1 滑石〜10 金剛石）。枠で囲まれていたら、正面からは歯が: The number beside a person is their hardness (1 talc to 10 diamond). If it's boxed, you can't touch them head-on.
statics.相手の体力・意志・信頼・手がかり。どれか一つを尽くせば決着がつく。倒すだけが終わ: Their body, will, trust, clues. Run any one of them out and it's settled. Beating them is not the only ending.
statics.相手は次の手を先に見せる。強い一撃の前は構え、話してくる時は話す。見せている手が: They show their next move first. Brace before a heavy blow; talk when they talk. The tell can be a lie.
statics.カードは使うと回数が減る（●）。0 回になっても、危うい別の効き目で使える。休む: Using a card spends a use (●). At 0 uses it still works — a riskier, different effect. Rest, or meet a condition, to get uses back.
statics.初めのカードは 3 枚。空き枠は、決着のあとに拾うカードで埋まっていく。何を拾う: You start with 3 cards. The empty slots fill with cards you pick up after each resolution. What you pick up decides who you are.
statics.同じフロアの隣の部屋へは、廊下を歩いて行ける。下りずに 1 時間。出来事と人の両: You can walk the hallway to the next room on the same floor. 1 hour, no descent. You get both the event and the person, but dawn draws closer.
statics.建物は一棟ではない。渡り廊下（2 時間）で隣の塔へ渡れる部屋がある。本棟では会わ: There is more than one building. Some rooms have a skybridge (2 hours) to the neighboring tower: faces you won't meet in the main tower, and rare shelves. Two floors down, it brings you back to the main tower.
statics.三つの道は、性格が違う。安定は勝ちやすいが得るものが少ない。高連鎖は噛み合うが崩: The three routes have different tempers. Steady wins easily but gains little. High chain meshes well but falls hard. Almost is the route where a strong build is nearly complete.
statics.［ ］つきの部屋は見せ場。タグの合うカードがよく効き、噛み合った数だけ見返りがあ: A room marked [ ] is a spotlight. Cards with matching tags hit harder, and every fit pays out. The foe is tougher too.
statics.歯が立たない相手からは退いていい。最後の相手からも。相手は傷を覚えていて、あとで: You may step back from anyone out of your league. Even the last foe. They remember the wound, and you can come back for a rematch.
statics.記憶（永続カード）は使わない。持っているだけで効き続け、組み合わさると新しい記憶: Memories (permanent cards) aren't played. Just holding them keeps them working, and in combination they open new memories and events.
statics.食堂では一つだけ選べる。休む・ひと晩・整える・一枚捨てる。カードの変質もここ。同: At the canteen you choose one thing: rest, stay the night, settle yourself, or discard a card. Card mutations happen here too. The more you rest within one section, the less it helps.
statics.古物商は、あなたが探しているものを聞きつけている。あと一つ足りないものが、棚に並: The antique dealer has heard what you're looking for. The one piece you're missing is sometimes on the shelf.
statics.ビルドが成立した。主役の札の第二章か、原型の四枚重ねで暴走する。暴走には必ず上限: A build has formed. A star card's second chapter, or four of one archetype stacked, sets off a surge. Every surge has a ceiling. Reach the peak and it comes off.
statics.振る舞いは噂になる。付いた冠は、会う前の相手の読みを変える。: What you do becomes rumor. A title changes how people read you before you meet.
statics.夜明け（08:00）を過ぎると、相手は荒れる。昼（12:00）になれば区画は閉じ: After dawn (08:00), they turn rough. At noon (12:00) the section closes. The sections below hold older nights.
statics.もう一人に、やられたあとだ。: The other one got to them first.
statics.もう一人と、もう打ち解けている。贈り物は向こうへ渡ったあとだ。: They've already warmed to the other one. The gift went that way.
statics.もう一人が、先に掘り返していた。: The other one dug it up first.
statics.相手の苛立ちが、目に見えて増していく。: Their irritation is plain to see now.
statics.廊下を歩いて、隣の部屋へ。: You walk the hallway to the next room.
statics.渡り廊下を戻って、本棟へ。: You take the skybridge back to the main tower.
statics.眠っているあいだに、そこには誰もいなくなっていた。: While you slept, whoever was there had gone.
statics.壁にもたれて、一服した。: You lean on the wall and take a breather.
statics.朝になった。建物じゅうの灯りが一斉に落ち、階段の扉が閉まる。あなたの灯りだけが、: Morning. Every light in the building goes out at once; the stairwell doors close. Only your lamp is still lit.
statics.あなたは底の手前で引き返した。立方体は、まだそこにある。次の夜も。: You turned back just short of the bottom. The cube is still there. The next night, too.
statics.あなたは自分の履歴を砕いた。土に戻った立方体の中に、何も残っていなかった。身軽に: You shattered your own history. The cube went back to earth, and nothing was left inside. You travel light now. Whether that's good, you can't tell yet.
statics.立方体は黙った。あなたの記憶は、もう何も言わない。夜明けの階段を、ひとりで上る。: The cube falls silent. Your memories say nothing anymore. You climb the dawn stairs alone.
statics.ぜんぶ持っていく、と決めた。重さはそのまま。それでも、歩ける。: You decide to carry all of it. The weight stays. You can still walk.
statics.最後の面に、彼女の名前があった。その下に、あなたの名前も。明かりをつける。約束ど: On the last face, her name. Under it, yours. You switch on the light. As promised.
statics.面をひとつずつ剥がしていくと、底に小さな空洞があった。何が入っていたのかは、もう: You peel the faces off one by one. At the bottom, a small hollow. What it held, you can no longer remember.
statics.約束は、古物商の棚に置いてきた。: The promise, you left on the antique dealer's shelf.
statics.次の区画へ下りる: Go down to the next section
statics.全ての札の回数 +1・体力と精神 +15%: All cards +1 use · body and mind +15%
statics.同じタグの札を続けると強くなる: Play cards sharing a tag back to back to grow stronger
statics.直前の札とタグが重なる札を続けて使うと、強くなる（三つ目まで重なる）: A card that shares a tag with the last one hits harder, stacking up to the third in a row
statics.カード・記憶・ビルド・エピテットが働くたびに、灯りが一つ増える: Each card, memory, build or epithet that takes effect lights one more lamp
statics.満ちた：決着で全部受け取る: Full: you receive it all when this ends
statics.暗闇で見る目と、消えない記憶。連鎖がひときわ深く効く（倍率 +0.3）。: Eyes made for the dark, and a memory that will not fade. Chains cut especially deep (multiplier +0.3).
statics.暗闇で見る目と、消えない記憶。連鎖がひときわ深く効く（+2）。: Eyes made for the dark, and a memory that will not fade. Chains cut especially deep (+2).
statics.扉の前で、息を整えた。: At the door, you steadied your breath.
statics.守りと構えを得る（次の一撃と脅しを受け止める）: Gain guard and composure (absorbs the next blow and threat)
statics.底の見えない建物を、フロアごとに下りる。三つ目の区画の底を抜ければ、ひとまず抜け: Descend a bottomless building, floor by floor. Get through the bottom of the third section and you are through, for now. Beyond that, as far as your build holds. You start with 3 cards and 2 empty slots.
statics.同じフロアの隣の部屋へは、廊下を歩いて行ける。下りずに 1 時間。出来事と人の両: You can walk the corridor to the next room on the same floor. One hour, without going down. You can take both the event and the person; the clock moves on.
statics.時計を見る。針がどこを指していても、下りるだけだ。: You check the clock. Wherever the hands point, you only go down.
statics.同じ札を続けると、二度目からは読まれる。: Play the same card twice in a row and the second is read.
statics.守りは固まって、手番をまたぐ。そのぶん、相手の一撃も重い。: Guard sets and carries across turns. Their blows land heavier for it.
statics.深いほど、秘密は固く、嘘が混じる。: The deeper, the harder secrets hold, and lies mix in.
statics.体と心、疲れ、札一枚の回数を戻す: Restore body, mind, fatigue, or one card's uses
statics.次に出会う相手との遭遇の初めに効く: Takes effect at the start of your next encounter
statics.この階を探る。出来事が起きるか、何かが見つかるか、誰かに気づかれる: Search this floor. Something may happen, turn up, or notice you
statics.疲れ −1・1 時間（この階で一度）。壁にもたれて、少しだけ息を整える。: Fatigue −1 · 1 h (once per floor). Lean on the wall and catch your breath.
statics.手持ちの札を全部広げる。エピテットを剥がして、別の札に刻み直せる。: Lay out your whole deck. Peel epithets off and inscribe them on other cards.
statics.遭遇のたびに、この中から五枚が配られる。使い切った札は、休むか、回数を増やすエピ: Each encounter deals five of these. A spent card sleeps until you rest or an epithet that adds uses settles on it.
statics.探して回ったが、何も起きなかった。: You search around, but nothing happens.
statics.物音に、誰かが気づいた。次の相手は、身構えて待っている。: Someone heard you. The next person is waiting, braced.
statics.札にエピテットが宿ることも: an epithet may settle on a card
statics.体と心 +10%・1 時間（この階で一度）: Body and mind +10% · 1 h (once per floor)
statics.右上の切り替えで、左の欄を地図から手札に替えられる。手札では七枚の札と手元のエピ: The switch at the top right turns the left pane from the map into your hand. There you see all seven cards, your epithets and your belongings: check spent cards, move epithets, use items.
statics.食堂では休み方を一つだけ選ぶ。休めば札が一枚、ひと晩なら二枚満ちるが、ひと晩は三: At the canteen you choose one way to rest. Resting refills one card, a night refills two, but a night takes three hours, misses the next event and lets every aftermath fade.
statics.手持ちはどの職でも七枚で、遭遇のたびに五枚が配られ、二枚は出番を待つ。拾うには一: Every job holds seven cards; each encounter deals five and two wait. Taking a card means letting one go, so after each settlement you choose: swap a spent card for a new one, or keep it and wait for an epithet that adds uses.
statics.手放す一枚を押す: Click the card to let go
statics.拾う一枚を選ぶ（手持ちはいっぱいなので、あとで一枚手放す）: Choose one to take (your hand is full, so you will let one go)
statics.壁にもたれて一服: Lean on the wall for a breather
statics.何か見つかりやすい・1 時間: More likely to find something · 1 h
